name: Atacama Desert
description: NASA POWER point-data prototype record; terrain and MODIS observations are not included.

provenance.spatial_resolution: Original NASA POWER source grid; see POWER response metadata.
provenance.processing_method: Arithmetic mean of valid NASA POWER daily T2M values; this is air temperature, not land-surface temperature.

quality.fill_value_rule: Values equal to POWER fill value or <= -900 are excluded.

provenance.spatial_resolution: Original NASA POWER source grid; see POWER response metadata.
provenance.processing_method: Minimum of valid NASA POWER daily T2M_MIN values; this is air temperature, not land-surface temperature.

quality.fill_value_rule: Values equal to POWER fill value or <= -900 are excluded.

provenance.spatial_resolution: Original NASA POWER source grid; see POWER response metadata.
provenance.processing_method: Maximum of valid NASA POWER daily T2M_MAX values; this is air temperature, not land-surface temperature.

quality.fill_value_rule: Values equal to POWER fill value or <= -900 are excluded.

features.label: Mean all-sky surface shortwave downward radiation

provenance.spatial_resolution: Original NASA POWER source grid; see POWER response metadata.
provenance.processing_method: Arithmetic mean of valid daily radiation values. This is not local terrain illumination, shadow duration, or solar incidence angle.

quality.fill_value_rule: Values equal to POWER fill value or <= -900 are excluded.

provenance.dataset_name: NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second V003 (SRTMGL1.003)
provenance.spatial_resolution: Native 1 arc-second HGT; local spacing 28.358 m east-west, 30.922 m north-south
provenance.temporal_resolution: Static DEM from the SRTM mission
provenance.processing_method: Native complete regional window targeting 9476.05 m physical support; relative elevation is center minus median, slope is a least-squares metric-plane gradient, roughness is plane-residual population standard deviation, and relief is max minus min.

quality.processing_crs: Local metric tangent-plane approximation at site latitude
quality.void_handling: Any NoData sample in the required window rejects all regional metrics; no interpolation.
quality.vertical_datum: Not inferred from HGT bytes; consult the verified SRTMGL1 product documentation for vertical reference.
